verdict.rationale: Aircall's own AI features run autonomously: AI Agents handle after-hours and peak-volume calls automatically, AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records and create follow-up tasks automatically, and agents can carry out multi-step actions like Shopify lookups, Stripe refunds, calendar booking and CRM logging. IVR routing with business-hours scheduling also runs on its own. The evidence is marketing-level, and the API/webhook tutorials are developer building blocks rather than a user-facing automation feature. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation/workflow builder (triggers, conditions, actions), detail on how users set up and control background automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
